lane: MAKE (3D studio, workshop, workbench, reverse, space, convert, game studio)

features.name: 3D studio: models
say: show me a toy car in 3D
find an oak dining chair model
features.does: Opens real free models from a catalogue, the samples, or a .glb file from your phone, and turns them round on a holographic bench

features.name: 3D studio: take apart and parts
features.does: Explodes a model into its parts; tap one to light it, isolate it or hide it
features.note: Parts are the file's own pieces, not named engineering parts

features.name: 3D studio: cut, measure and view
features.does: Slices the model along X, Y or Z, measures between two tapped points, and draws it solid, wireframe or X-ray
features.note: A model made from a photo has no real size, and it says so

features.name: 3D studio: make from words or a photo
say: make a 3D model from this photo
features.does: Finds a real model for your words, or makes one from a picture with a free generator, kept on your phone
features.note: Depends on free generators being up; quality varies

features.name: 3D studio: room, walk-through, spline, car fix-it, design a build
features.where: 3D STUDIO → Room / Spline / Car · fix it / Design a build
say: design me a shed three by two
features.does: Builds your Space plan in 3D to walk round, opens Spline scenes, guides a car fix, and designs a simple build with a first-estimate materials list
features.note: Builds and prices are first estimates

features.name: Space: room planner
features.where: MAKE → SPACE → Room plan, Rooms · walls
say: add a window on the back wall
features.does: Your rooms to scale with real wall thickness, L-shapes, doors (with swing) and windows, areas in m² and ft²

features.name: Space: furniture, will it fit, make space
features.where: SPACE → Add furniture / Will it fit? / Make space
say: make more space in my bedroom
features.does: UK-size furniture to drag about, walkways under 70 cm and clashes in red, a fit check before buying, and up to three roomier layouts with UNDO

features.name: Space: design my home and design review
features.where: SPACE → Design my home (top), Design review
say: my lounge is 5 by 4 metres with the door on the left
features.does: Draws a home from your words, and suggests changes you see before and after and apply only on APPLY
features.note: Needs the brain (it says so when offline)

features.name: Space: from photo and measured
say: make a plan from this photo
features.does: Reads a drawn plan from a photo, or rough room sizes from room photos, and brings in Lens measurements
features.note: Room photos are rough and need a 50 MB download once (on your tap); doors and windows from room photos aren't found

features.name: Space: materials
features.does: Paint in real tin sizes, flooring with 10% extra, skirting and wallpaper rolls for your plan, a first estimate
features.note: No prices; a door between two rooms comes off one room only; no chat phrase opens it yet

features.name: Space: export and import
features.does: Saves the plan as a picture or a file, loads a file back with UNDO, and opens it in 3D

features.name: Workbench: engineering estimates
features.where: MAKE → WORKBENCH → Structure / Drive / Flight / Home
say: 3 m steel beam 5 kN in the middle
how much heat does my lounge lose
features.does: Beam, column, gears, bicycle, engine, wing, car drag, falling, projectile, orbit, heat loss, sun and shadow, and circuits (LED, Ohm's law, resistors, divider, RC, running cost), answered as you type in your units
features.note: Every answer says FIRST ESTIMATE · NOT CERTIFIED

features.name: Workbench: copy an estimate
features.does: Copies the whole estimate with its not-certified label on top

features.name: Workbench: wind tunnel
features.does: A live 2-D airflow round a shape you draw with your finger, with its drag

features.name: Convert: files
features.does: Pictures, PDFs, Word, tables and sound into other formats, on the phone, with SAVE and SHARE
features.note: Video conversion isn't done (it says so)

features.name: Convert: unit pad
features.does: Twelve kinds of unit, answered as you type, with swap, every unit at once, copy and recent conversions kept

features.name: Convert: no-file tools
features.where: CONVERT → QR code / Money / Base64 / Unix time / Paste a table / Record
features.does: QR codes (Wi-Fi too), money at a rate you type or today's rate from the chat, base64, Unix time, a pasted table into CSV, a voice recording as WAV
features.note: No live money rate on the phone; the chat asks the brain with its source

features.name: Game studio
say: sketch a cave room with two ledges
features.does: Makes 2-D platformers and top-down adventures with rooms, sprites, characters who talk and sell, things, quests, rules and sound; play, share as a file, or put on your sites behind APPROVE

features.name: Workshop
features.where: MAKE → WORKSHOP → Build / Ideas / Changes / Made / Training
features.does: Ghosty changes himself: tell him what to build, see proposed changes with a preview and checks, ship or discard, roll back, widgets, projects that run for days, the kernel lock, the training ground, published pages

features.name: Reverse
features.does: Paste a link to a website, package, public project or file, and a report on how it's built arrives in a few minutes
features.note: Lawful research only; runs on GitHub's free computers, so it needs that connection

upward.why: Share a model as a short clip, like product apps do
Come back to 'the shed beam' with every number as it was

upward.why: The extra tabs specialist converter apps have

sideways.why: The room planner outdoors: beds, paths, sun and shade through the day
sideways.builds_on: Space plan + Workbench sun and shadow

sideways.why: Units in standard UK sizes that snap to walls, with a parts list

sideways.idea: DIY job planner: tools, materials and steps for a job
sideways.why: From 'put up a shelf' to a list and a first-estimate load check
Check a model is printable, scale it and save an STL

sideways.idea: Electrics helper: socket loads and cable sizes as a first estimate
sideways.why: Know before calling an electrician what to ask

sideways.idea: Car corner: tyre size, gearing and fuel cost calculators
sideways.why: Answers about his car in his units

sideways.why: Will my furniture fit the new place, and in what van
Double a recipe with units converted right

sideways.why: A choose-your-path story maker for people who don't want platforms

sideways.idea: Escape-room maker from his own floor plan
sideways.why: Turn his house plan into a game level
